programme.title: Bodyguards and Assassins
programme.desc: 1906, City of Victoria (British Colony of Hong Kong). In the distance of thirteen blocks, the one man who holds a nation's fate must survive relentless attempts on his life with only eight bodyguards to protect him. Against hundreds of assassins, these men must put their courage to the test in order to protect the hopes of millions in this perilous night even if it means fighting to the death...

programme.title: Making of Cesium Fallout
programme.desc: Directed by Anthony Pun, 'Cesium Fallout' is the first Hong Kong's historic first radiation disaster blockbuster that has won 5 nominations at the 43rd Hong Kong Film Awards. This documentary has recorded every little bits of behind-the-scene as well as the sharing from Anthony Pun, the cast and the production crew.

programme.title: A Light Never Goes Out
programme.desc: Widow Mei-heung has gone through countless sleepless nights since the death of her husband, Bill. One day, she finds a key among the items that Bill left behind, leading her to his secret neon workshop and his young apprentice, Leo. She learns from Leo that Bill had an unfulfilled last wish–to recreate a demolished legendary neon sign. With Leo's help, Mei-heung tries to uncover the story behind the sign and learns the craft of blowing neon lights in hopes of fulfilling her deceased husband's last wish with her own hands. Along the way, Mei-heung reminisces about her beautiful encounters with Bill and unearths pieces of Bill's past as if they are the last consolation left by him. Meanwhile, Mei-heung's daughter, Prism, plans to leave Hong Kong with her fiance, but she is unable to break the news to Mei-heung. As clues of the legendary neon sign gradually emerge, the secrets that Mei-heung couldn't face are about to be revealed...

programme.title: E7 - Cambodia: Hidden Refuges
programme.desc: Bisected by the Mekong’s mighty waters, Cambodia is defined by its relationship to this great river. See why the country is a biodiversity hot spot and explore the secret refuges of animal populations that survive in its untouched natural habitats.

programme.desc: Join two seriously ill orangutans in the medical clinic, where Erik’s head infection is causing concern and fourteen-year-old Mia’s life depends on a blood transfusion. Outside the clinic, the infants find a secret treat hidden inside a rubber tree.

programme.title: E2
programme.desc: 在最重視了解自然災害和吉凶的日本有著世界上最古老的調查機構「全領域異常解決辦公室」以解決難以想像的「無法解釋的異常案件」。但似乎隱藏著一個巨大的秘密. .....人們面對的「異常事件」，例如無法用科學解釋的超自然現象。這是一個可能真實發生在你身邊的故事。甚麼是真實的，甚麼是虛構的？ 真相在下一刻就變成了妄想。

programme.title: E24
programme.desc: 芭蕾舞藝術家譚思婷退役歸國，欲與當年被迫分開的戀人馮睿破鏡重圓，但是過去的誤會如同天塹一般隔斷兩人。如今的馮睿獨自一個人帶著孩子，生活如同深潭靜水，譚思婷回來如同一顆石子攪亂了一切。而譚思婷身邊也有一個默默愛了她十年的暗戀者，這次勇敢追愛對她不離不棄。馮睿和譚思婷彼此逃避對方，但是命運的漩渦卻不斷將兩人裡挾其中，令他們愛恨兩難。

programme.title: E8
programme.desc: 大學時期的男主角月岡夏，與同學南雲水季交往起來，並過著幸福的日子。然而，正當他們都在忙著就業活動的時候，水季卻突然向他提出分手，從此兩人分道揚鑣。就這樣過了七年，已經開展新生活的夏，卻突然收到大學時代朋友的通知，原來水季已經離開了人世。從分手那天起就沒有再見過水季的夏，帶著難以置信的心情去參加了水季的葬禮。在葬禮上，夏見到了一個名叫海的小女孩，並得知她是水季和他的女兒，讓他感到十分震驚。原來當年水季竟瞞著他生下了他們的孩子，並且一直默默地撫養著這個孩子。知道這一切以後，夏開始思考水季和海在這七年間的生活。

programme.title: E24
programme.desc: 芭蕾舞藝術家譚思婷退役歸國，欲與當年被迫分開的戀人馮睿破鏡重圓，但是過去的誤會如同天塹一般隔斷兩人。如今的馮睿獨自一個人帶著孩子，生活如同深潭靜水，譚思婷回來如同一顆石子攪亂了一切。而譚思婷身邊也有一個默默愛了她十年的暗戀者，這次勇敢追愛對她不離不棄。馮睿和譚思婷彼此逃避對方，但是命運的漩渦卻不斷將兩人裡挾其中，令他們愛恨兩難。

programme.title: E48
programme.desc: In Onjeong Market, located in Onjeong, a town some distance away from Seoul, the area is buzzing with change as apartment complexes are built and plans for subway extensions and new town developments are announced. Across a single street stand a principled general hospital, Gongmyeongjeongdae Clinic, and traditional Korean clinic, Yangji Barun Clinic. The two families who run these places have been bitter enemies for years, bound by a long standing grudge from an incident in the past. Even the smallest matters turn into big fights, making them the most famous rival families in Onjeong. This is a family growth drama about these two families as they unravel their long held misunderstandings, heal their wounds, learn to love one another, and are reborn as one family.

programme.title: E17
programme.desc: The drama is the first 'historic science' drama that has been produced in Korea. This drama depicts the successful life story of the scientist Jang Youngsil that contributed to the development and accomplishment of Joseon's science during the 15th century. In particular, the drama emphasizes his accomplishment through showing the restrictions and difficulties he experienced due to his social class as a slave. Moreover, the drama aims to depict Jang Youngsil as the role model of 'Korea's youth of the 21st century' through displaying his scientific accomplishments. The drama also expects to stimulate scientific curiosity amongst audiences and help them easily understand the fundamental principles of science by utilizing various data and scientific videos.

E1 - A Super Fun Underwater Sing-Along!
programme.desc: Get ready for a super fun underwater sing-along with The Sharksons! Join the fun as five little reef sharks learn their lesson about jumping on the bed. Then, meet an 'Itsy Bitsy' sea spider who keeps trying to climb an underwater cliff with a little help from her friends! The classic rhymes continue with a curious crab acting out the story of Humpty Dumpty & a cozy pajama party with ten friends in a bed. It's a sing-along full of classic tunes with a fun, fishy twist!

programme.title: E6 - JJ's Birthday Surprise
programme.desc: Join JJ for his birthday celebration! His friends and family are setting up a surprise party, but things keep going wrong. From a party bus to a farm adventure and even a train ride, celebrate with games, gifts, and a hunt for Bingo!

programme.title: E5 - A Birthday Gift for a Friend!
programme.desc: Celebrate with Buster and his friends! It's Digley's birthday, then Scout's, with a giant, toppling ice cream. Later, Ash has a party, but Buster feels unwell. For his own birthday, Buster must teach Bandit to share and play nicely.

programme.title: E3 - A BIG Birthday Surprise!
programme.desc: Join JJ and his animal pals for Emmy the elephant's birthday! Play a game of musical chairs, go on a submarine ride to see colorful sharks, and help rescue Mochi's rubber ducky at the beach. It's an animal-filled day of fun and adventure!

programme.title: E6 - JJ's Birthday Surprise
programme.desc: Join JJ for his birthday celebration! His friends and family are setting up a surprise party, but things keep going wrong. From a party bus to a farm adventure and even a train ride, celebrate with games, gifts, and a hunt for Bingo!

programme.title: E3 - Baby John's Fun Animal Playtime!
programme.desc: Get ready for some fun animal playtime with Baby John! He & Manny are playing with their animal toys & a bus. With the help of their imagination, they travel into a fantastic animal world where their toys become real! Then, Baby John has fun in his play pretend veterinary clinic, treating his dog Bingo as one of his patients. The animal fun continues as the family tries to give a very stinky Bingo a bath!

programme.title: The Melon Patch S1E12 -Let's Eat Healthy Food!
programme.desc: Ms. Appleberry and the Melon Patch teachers explore everything about healthy food: where it comes from, where we can buy it, trying new foods, and how it helps us get energy, stay healthy, and grow strong!

programme.title: E2 - Underwater Learning Adventures!
programme.desc: Dive into some underwater learning adventures with The Sharksons! First, join the sea friends as they swim through the alphabet to learn their ABCs. Then, explore the vibrant hues of Splashy Reef with a journey to learn all the shades of a beautiful rainbow. The learning continues with important daily routines! Sing along with Tucker the Turtle as he takes a bath & watch as Baby Grub eagerly learns the importance of dental care by brushing her big, sharp shark teeth!

programme.title: E4 - Baby John's Fun Learning Adventure!
programme.desc: Join Baby John on a fun learning adventure! First, playing dress-up is so much fun! Baby John transforms into a pirate, Jack is an astronaut & Jill is a beautiful princess! Then, 'please' & 'thank you' are very important words, & Baby John learns just how magical they can be. The learning continues as his family helps him to understand the opposite concept of 'open & shut' & Dad helps him play with his brand-new color train!

programme.title: E4 - Baby John's Family Are His Heroes!
programme.desc: Baby John thinks his family members are the best heroes! He really loves & admires his dad, & wants to copy everything he does to be just like him. His big brother Jack is a hero, too, & is always willing to help his little brother & teach him new things. After Mom's cupcakes go missing, Baby John dresses up as a police officer to find out who took them, interviewing each of his family member heroes!

programme.title: The Melon Patch S1E12 -Let's Eat Healthy Food!
programme.desc: Ms. Appleberry and the Melon Patch teachers explore everything about healthy food: where it comes from, where we can buy it, trying new foods, and how it helps us get energy, stay healthy, and grow strong!

programme.title: E1 - A Super Fun Day with Cody!
programme.desc: Spend a super fun day with Cody from morning to night! Join Toni & Cody as they bond during a special Hair Wash Day, where they scrub, rinse & comb his perfect curls. Then, Cody dresses up in a safari outfit & leads his Dad on a quest through a jungle-like environment to find dinosaurs! The fun day ends with a silly bedtime routine where his parents make deliberate mistakes, prompting laughs from Cody as he 'corrects' them.

programme.title: E1 - Orphle's Big Day of Trouble!
programme.desc: It's a big day of trouble, all thanks to Orphle! First, he uses a Multicolour Cloner to make different colored clones of himself, & it's up to Mila & Morphle to track them all down before they cause too much chaos. Then, when the friends are playing in a cardboard castle, Orphle mistakenly thinks they don't want to play with him & attacks it! From stealing a treasure map to teaming up with Winston, Orphle is causing trouble all day!

programme.title: The Melon Patch S1E1 -Yummy! It's Mealtime
programme.desc: Ms. Appleberry and the Melon Patch teachers make mealtime a delicious discovery. Through stories and songs, kids explore the joy of eating, practice mealtime routines, and learn when to use forks and spoons.

programme.title: E3 - Wonders Of The World & Beyond!
programme.desc: Join Blippi on an adventure to the wonders of our world & beyond! First, he travels to the tallest mountain on Earth, Mt. Everest, with his new friend Betty the Yeti. Then, he dives deep into the ocean to explore a kelp forest with Jerry the Jellyfish. The adventure gets explosive as Blippi & FETCH fly into a volcano! After exploring the Earth, Blippi blasts off into space to tour the solar system, learn about gravity on the moon & discover how rainbows get their amazing colors!

programme.title: E2 - A Calming Night with Twinkle!
programme.desc: Have a calming & magical night with Twinkle the star! When Bao Bao struggles to sleep, Twinkle arrives & transforms into a hot air balloon to lift her cot into the night sky so she can see the moon. Then, she helps Max, Muffin & Bao Bao get ready for bed by transforming into a cuddly teddy bear to give them all warm goodnight hugs. From creating a magical rainbow over the bath to turning into a kite for a gentle ride, Twinkle always makes bedtime magical.

From creating a magical rainbow over the bath to turning into a kite for a gentle ride, Twinkle always makes bedtime magical.

programme.title: E1 - A Super Fun Underwater Sing-Along!
programme.desc: Get ready for a super fun underwater sing-along with The Sharksons! Join the fun as five little reef sharks learn their lesson about jumping on the bed. Then, meet an 'Itsy Bitsy' sea spider who keeps trying to climb an underwater cliff with a little help from her friends! The classic rhymes continue with a curious crab acting out the story of Humpty Dumpty & a cozy pajama party with ten friends in a bed. It's a sing-along full of classic tunes with a fun, fishy twist!

programme.title: E1 - A Super Fun Day with Cody!
programme.desc: Spend a super fun day with Cody from morning to night! Join Toni & Cody as they bond during a special Hair Wash Day, where they scrub, rinse & comb his perfect curls. Then, Cody dresses up in a safari outfit & leads his Dad on a quest through a jungle-like environment to find dinosaurs! The fun day ends with a silly bedtime routine where his parents make deliberate mistakes, prompting laughs from Cody as he 'corrects' them.

programme.title: The Melon Patch S1E1 -Yummy! It's Mealtime
programme.desc: Ms. Appleberry and the Melon Patch teachers make mealtime a delicious discovery. Through stories and songs, kids explore the joy of eating, practice mealtime routines, and learn when to use forks and spoons.

programme.title: E2 - Underwater Learning Adventures!
programme.desc: Dive into some underwater learning adventures with The Sharksons! First, join the sea friends as they swim through the alphabet to learn their ABCs. Then, explore the vibrant hues of Splashy Reef with a journey to learn all the shades of a beautiful rainbow. The learning continues with important daily routines! Sing along with Tucker the Turtle as he takes a bath & watch as Baby Grub eagerly learns the importance of dental care by brushing her big, sharp shark teeth!

programme.title: E3 - Wonders Of The World & Beyond!
programme.desc: Join Blippi on an adventure to the wonders of our world & beyond! First, he travels to the tallest mountain on Earth, Mt. Everest, with his new friend Betty the Yeti. Then, he dives deep into the ocean to explore a kelp forest with Jerry the Jellyfish. The adventure gets explosive as Blippi & FETCH fly into a volcano! After exploring the Earth, Blippi blasts off into space to tour the solar system, learn about gravity on the moon & discover how rainbows get their amazing colors!

programme.title: E6 - JJ's Birthday Surprise
programme.desc: Join JJ for his birthday celebration! His friends and family are setting up a surprise party, but things keep going wrong. From a party bus to a farm adventure and even a train ride, celebrate with games, gifts, and a hunt for Bingo!

programme.title: The Melon Patch S1E1 -Yummy! It's Mealtime

programme.title: E1 - Orphle's Big Day of Trouble!
programme.desc: It's a big day of trouble, all thanks to Orphle! First, he uses a Multicolour Cloner to make different colored clones of himself, & it's up to Mila & Morphle to track them all down before they cause too much chaos. Then, when the friends are playing in a cardboard castle, Orphle mistakenly thinks they don't want to play with him & attacks it! From stealing a treasure map to teaming up with Winston, Orphle is causing trouble all day!

programme.title: The Melon Patch S1E12 -Let's Eat Healthy Food!
programme.desc: Ms. Appleberry and the Melon Patch teachers explore everything about healthy food: where it comes from, where we can buy it, trying new foods, and how it helps us get energy, stay healthy, and grow strong!

programme.title: E2 - Ice Storm
programme.desc: Chief Pilot AJ Decoste is flying up the Mackenzie Valley with Buffalo’s newest Electra, XFC, for the first time. Mechanic Cory Dodd is along for the ride to do some training as a Flight Engineer. They try to make their deliveries before a storm rolls in but when they land in Norman Wells, they are faced with gale force winds. When their takeoff is delayed by two incoming planes, AJ is forced to shut down and wait out the storm in Norman Wells. Later, on their approach to Tulita, they face even stronger winds gusting over 40 knots. Over in Hay River, things go from bad to worse when a warm weather system brings the threat of a rare ice storm. Two daily skeds arrive from Yellowknife and the rampies have to batten down the DC-3s in preparation for a long, rough night—the worst storm in fifty years. And the newest rampie, CJ Asaf, just can’t seem to fit in. Rampie Prefkar is tasked with training CJ on the Hay River delivery route, but Prefkar can’t handle CJ or his attitude.

programme.desc: Tariffs: a bargaining chip that changes the world. On July 24th, the 10% tariffs imposed by Trump under Section 122 of the Trade Act expired. Will the Section 301 weapon fall again? programme.title: From Riches To Rags
programme.desc: Ricky and Fatso are friends in need. They are in dire need of money since they are only paid slave wages at the bottling factory. By nature, Ricky is a dreamer. In his day dreams, he is romancing with Jo Jo, the movie idol. Ricky and Fatso buy a lottery ticket and become millionaires overnight. In one of these nights out in town, Ricky is suddenly attacked by an upset stomach. In no time, a quack doctor diagnoses the seizure as terminal cancer. Ricky seriously considers suicide. But he is also appalled by the drawbacks inherent in the many methods of doing himself in primarily the pain. It is on a rooftop from which he is supposed to make a plunge that he saves a poor man from suicide by giving the latter all the money he has. In gratitude, the newly rich man promises to hire a killer to finish off his suffering benefactor...

programme.title: Back To Our 1994: The New Legend of Shaolin
programme.desc: Hung Hei Kwun, a kungfu student of Shaolin, is against the Manchu rulers. Hung's whole family was arrested and later beheaded. Hung killed Ning-Erh Ma in revenge and escaped with his youngest son, Man-Ting, to nowhere land. Several years later, Chishan, Father Superior of the Shaolin Temple, found a map to a treasure trove but contents were tattooed on the backs of his five young masters. If missing one master, the trove could not be found...

programme.title: From Riches To Rags
programme.desc: Ricky and Fatso are friends in need. They are in dire need of money since they are only paid slave wages at the bottling factory. By nature, Ricky is a dreamer. In his day dreams, he is romancing with Jo Jo, the movie idol. Ricky and Fatso buy a lottery ticket and become millionaires overnight. In one of these nights out in town, Ricky is suddenly attacked by an upset stomach. In no time, a quack doctor diagnoses the seizure as terminal cancer. Ricky seriously considers suicide. But he is also appalled by the drawbacks inherent in the many methods of doing himself in primarily the pain. It is on a rooftop from which he is supposed to make a plunge that he saves a poor man from suicide by giving the latter all the money he has. In gratitude, the newly rich man promises to hire a killer to finish off his suffering benefactor...

programme.title: E1
programme.desc: 遊遍江蘇全省的名勝古蹟和大街小巷，尋訪文史學家、學者，走訪民間藝人工匠等，探尋風景背後的動人故事，深度觸摸江蘇的文化脈搏，帶領大家發現江蘇的獨特魅力。

programme.title: E65
programme.desc: 兼顧情緒價值輸出，為女性量身打造兼具時尚審美與人文關懷的變裝微綜藝，全方位多角度地向社會傳遞積極的生活態度；種草生活好物、推薦文旅線路、科普健康知識。

programme.title: E41 - 非典型IT男登場
programme.desc: 《非誠勿擾》全新改版，24位女嘉賓分為心動區和觀察區，男嘉賓暫不亮相，在「第二現場」與女嘉賓隔空對話。男女嘉賓通過雙向選擇，決定兩人能否成功牽手。

programme.title: E1 - 入廠名額爭奪戰開啟
programme.desc: 由周杰倫擔當音樂造夢者，召集夢想生活官劉畊宏和夢想見證官王鶴棣，及四組廠牌經理人GAI周延&布瑞吉Bridge、歐陽靖&小鬼王琳凱、艾熱&早安、VaVa&盛宇，一同為說唱新生代們的追夢之旅保駕護航；打破傳統導師帶隊模式，通過構建真實師徒關系，共同打造獨具特色的說唱廠牌；透過競演激發說唱歌手創作才華，在全民中尋找下一個說唱巨星。

programme.title: E27
programme.desc: 蒼梧國大將軍之女羲和遭滅門及暗算，重生為廢柴嫡女沈千夜。她懷著滿腔不甘踏上復仇之路，與疑似凶手的「小皇叔」裴夙糾纏不休。在調查真相的過程中，兩人從相互算計到聯手抗敵，揭開了蒼梧國隱藏的重重秘密。

programme.title: E15
programme.desc: 《誰是兇手》講述了一起發生在海舟市的連環兇案，在真相塵封了十七年之後，與這宗懸案有著千絲萬縷聯繫的人們，在各自不可告人的秘密中，一起等待真相浮出水面的故事。 2001年寒冬，海舟市印刷廠家屬院發生了一起命案。新人刑警冷小兵和師兄接到一起報案奔赴現場，卻意外面對海舟市連環殺人案的兇手。冷小兵膽怯不敢開槍，兇手從現場逃走並殺害了師兄李嵐。現場另一名目擊證人是躲在床下的夏木。為繼續留在警隊冷小兵隱瞞了不敢開槍的事，夏木也沒有揭穿他。至此兇手藏匿起來，海舟案懸而未決。十七年後，夏木來到警隊實習，以冷小兵不敢開槍的事作為把柄，要挾他和自己一起查案。而伴随着神秘的心理医生沈雨的出现，一起几乎与十七年前一模一样的案子再次发生，而沈雨身上一个又一个疑团频频出现，凶手究竟是谁？

programme.title: E19
programme.desc: 特務機構雪衣衛首領風作人奉嘉帝之命，潛入定遠侯府尋找前朝太子，意圖斬草除根。然而在這個過程中，鳳作人卻發現嘉帝的背後有人正在佈置更大的陰謀。

programme.desc: 法醫齊思哲在調查女友死因的過程中，捲入一樁樁懸案，與刑警祝青越、韓烽攜手屢破詭案，並牽扯出背後「原鑽」毒品疑案的故事。

programme.title: E2
programme.desc: 人生進入瓶頸期的職場精英梁友安和習慣了坐冷板凳的運動員宋三川，因緣際會加入了一個草臺網球俱樂部。他們一個是半路出家的俱樂部經理人，一個是羽毛球轉網球的運動員，兩人和隊友們克服困難共同奮戰，努力打造一個了不起的職業俱樂部。在此過程中，梁友安和宋三川逐漸萌生愛意，也面臨著來自觀念和閱歷的衝突。俱樂部不斷髮展，他們在一次次應對挑戰中超越自我、加強信任，最終收穫職業成長和美好愛情。
